🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 10, 2026

Sun, in its fall in Libra, holds a conjunction to Moon, without title in the same sign. The same air temperament, twice over: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From there it squares Venus. From Libra, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Cardinal fire meets a bill. The Cancer chapter closed four weeks ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from Scorpio, where none of its habits work. Mars in Leo stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fixed earth pays to hold on. The trine to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Sun trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. Mercury left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Libra. Sun in Libra presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, is at its lowest in Libra: effort costs double. Moon sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Sun has been out of Virgo for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you from Scorpio, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Venus in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Sun is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Cardinal air: beginning and paying are one act. Retrograde since two weeks ago, Venus is still re-reading.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Venus is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. The hold Sun had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Libra, Moon hands you an opening. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. Two weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Saturn; that is finished.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Moon in Libra squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Earth opens the file, and the file has a price. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon trines you from Libra, and the ease asks its own attention. Air that holds on, holding without strain. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Scorpio, Venus makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. Nothing about it is a week old.
